title: Signature Web Crawl Tier 1
summary: Signature-authored plan for a 2T-token curated web corpus: crawl sources, quality tiers, and license posture, designed by JAH.
details: Signature Web Crawl Tier 1 is a JAH-designed compilation plan for a two-trillion-token web corpus built only from permissively licensed or public-domain sources plus licensed publisher feeds. The plan defines three quality tiers (Tier 1 editorial, Tier 2 curated forums/docs, Tier 3 broad web), a MinHash dedup budget, and a per-document license ledger so every token carries provenance. It is a compilation design — the corpus is assembled by running the plan — and is labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Tiered corpus budget planner

title: JAH Instruction Forge
summary: Signature-authored design for a 5M-pair instruction corpus: task taxonomy, generation recipes, and quality gates.
details: JAH Instruction Forge is a JAH-original compilation design covering five million instruction-response pairs across a 400-task taxonomy (coding, math, writing, reasoning, tool use). The design specifies generation recipes per task family, a three-stage quality gate (format check, model-judge scoring, human audit sample), and a contamination screen against 40 public benchmarks. Every pair carries task-family and difficulty labels for curriculum use. Labeled Signature; the pairs are produced by executing the design.

demo.title: Task taxonomy sampler

title: Signature Code Quarry
summary: Signature-authored plan for a 1 TB permissive-license code corpus with per-file license ledger.
details: Signature Code Quarry is a JAH-designed code corpus plan targeting one terabyte of source code drawn strictly from permissive licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC), with a per-file license ledger and an opt-out registry honoring developer requests. The design includes language-balanced sampling across 80 languages, near-dedup at repository level, and a secrets scanner that strips keys and tokens before packaging. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: License ledger check
demo.program:
allowed = {"mit", "apache-2.0", "bsd-2-clause", "bsd-3-clause", "isc"}
ledger = [{"file": "net.py", "license": "mit"},
          {"file": "ui.js", "license": "gpl-3.0"}]
clean = [e for e in ledger if e["license"] in allowed]
print("admitted:", [e["file"] for e in clean])

title: JAH Multimodal Pairs
summary: Signature-authored design for 500M curated image-text pairs with CLIP-score and safety filtering.
details: JAH Multimodal Pairs is a JAH-original plan for half a billion image-text pairs: source from openly licensed image repositories, filter by CLIP similarity (>=0.30), run NSFW and watermark detectors, and keep per-pair source URLs plus license tags. The design adds a multilingual caption-expansion stage that machine-translates captions into 20 languages with human audit sampling. Labeled Signature; pairs are produced by running the plan.
license: Signature compilation plan; per-pair license tags

demo.title: Pair filtering sketch
demo.program:
pairs = [{"clip": 0.34, "nsfw": 0.01}, {"clip": 0.22, "nsfw": 0.02},
          {"clip": 0.41, "nsfw": 0.80}]
kept = [p for p in pairs if p["clip"] >= 0.30 and p["nsfw"] < 0.10]
print(f"kept {len(kept)}/{len(pairs)} pairs")

title: Signature Speech Mine
summary: Signature-authored plan for 50K hours of transcribed speech across 40 languages.
details: Signature Speech Mine is a JAH-designed speech corpus plan: 50,000 hours of transcribed audio spanning 40 languages, sourced from public-domain audiobooks, licensed podcast feeds, and community contributions. The design specifies a transcription pipeline (base ASR + human correction on a 5% audit slice), speaker-diversity quotas, and noise-condition labels (clean, street, call-center) so models train robustly. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Language hour quotas
demo.program:
langs = 40
total_hours = 50_000
quota = {"en": 0.30}
rest = (1 - quota["en"]) / (langs - 1)
quotas = {"en": quota["en"] * total_hours}
quotas.update({f"lang_{i}": rest * total_hours for i in range(1, langs)})
print("en hours:", quotas["en"], "| others each:", round(quotas["lang_1"]))

title: JAH Textbook Vault
summary: Signature-authored plan for 100K open textbooks distilled into a clean educational corpus.
details: JAH Textbook Vault is a JAH-original design for a 100,000-textbook educational corpus built from openly licensed textbooks (OpenStax-style) plus public-domain classics. The plan adds a distillation stage: long chapters are compressed into study-note form by a teacher model, then verified against the source, producing parallel long/short pairs for training models that explain clearly. Labeled Signature; the corpus is built by executing the plan.

demo.title: Chapter distillation record

title: Signature Math Proofs Corpus
summary: Signature-authored design for 2M formal and informal math proofs with step labels.
details: This JAH-designed corpus plan targets two million mathematics proofs: formal proofs in Lean/Coq style plus informal textbook proofs, each annotated with step boundaries and the theorem it proves. The design includes an autoformalization track (informal to Lean, checked by the kernel) and a difficulty ladder from arithmetic to graduate topics. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Proof step record
demo.program:
proof = {"theorem": "sqrt(2) is irrational",
           "steps": ["assume sqrt(2)=a/b reduced",
                     "then 2b^2=a^2, so a even",
                     "then b even: contradiction"]}
print(f"{proof['theorem']}: {len(proof['steps'])} steps")

title: JAH Dialogue Garden
summary: Signature-authored plan for 10M multi-turn conversations across 60 scenario families.
details: JAH Dialogue Garden is a JAH-original design for ten million multi-turn dialogues spanning 60 scenario families (customer support, tutoring, negotiation, brainstorming, therapy-adjacent wellness coaching with safety rails). Each dialogue carries scenario, turn count, and outcome labels, and a 1% slice gets human quality review. The plan forbids real private conversations — all dialogues are synthetic or actor-performed. Labeled Signature.

demo.title: Dialogue schema validation
demo.program:
d = {"scenario": "tutoring", "turns": [
    {"role": "user", "text": "Explain fractions."},
    {"role": "assistant", "text": "A fraction is part of a whole."}]}
assert all(t["role"] in ("user", "assistant") for t in d["turns"])
print("valid dialogue:", d["scenario"], len(d["turns"]), "turns")

title: Signature Law Library
summary: Signature-authored plan for a public-domain statutes-and-cases corpus with citation graphs.
details: Signature Law Library is a JAH-designed corpus plan covering public-domain statutes, regulations, and court opinions with a citation graph linking cases to the statutes they interpret. The plan includes jurisdiction tags, date versioning (law changes over time), and a plain-language summary track for accessibility. It uses only public-domain government works — no proprietary legal databases. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Citation graph edge

title: JAH Medical Text Atlas
summary: Signature-authored plan for a licensed medical-text corpus with strict provenance and review gates.
details: JAH Medical Text Atlas is a JAH-original design for a medical training corpus built only from licensed textbooks, open-access journals, and public health guidance — never scraped patient data. The plan requires clinician review of sampled passages, versioned snapshots (medicine changes), and a 'not medical advice' training wrapper so models learn to defer to professionals. Labeled Signature; a design for responsible medical data.

demo.title: Provenance gate
demo.program:
passages = [{"src": "licensed_textbook", "ok": True},
             {"src": "random_forum", "ok": False}]
admitted = [p for p in passages if p["ok"]]
print("admitted:", len(admitted), "/", len(passages))

title: Signature Science Papers
summary: Signature-authored plan for an open-access papers corpus with figure-caption pairing.
details: This JAH-designed plan assembles open-access scientific papers (arXiv, PubMed Central, open journals) into a corpus pairing full text with figures, captions, and citation contexts. The design adds a field-normalized metadata layer (discipline, methods, datasets used) so models can train on 'papers that use dataset X'. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Paper metadata record

title: JAH Low-Resource Languages
summary: Signature-authored plan for text corpora in 200 low-resource languages with community review.
details: JAH Low-Resource Languages is a JAH-original design for building text corpora in 200 underserved languages: community-contributed text, public-domain books, and translated seed sets, each reviewed by native speakers. The plan sets minimum quality bars per language and a speaker-compensation policy. Labeled Signature; a design for linguistic inclusion.

demo.title: Coverage tracker
demo.program:
langs = ["qu", "yo", "sw", "my", "km"]
status = {l: "seeded" for l in langs}
status["sw"] = "reviewed"
print("reviewed:", [l for l, s in status.items() if s == "reviewed"])

title: Signature Preference Pairs
summary: Signature-authored design for 3M human-preference pairs for RLHF/DPO training.
details: Signature Preference Pairs is a JAH-designed plan for three million (prompt, chosen, rejected) triples for preference training, spanning helpfulness, honesty, and safety axes. The design specifies annotator guidelines, inter-annotator agreement targets (>=0.7), and a held-out eval split that never enters training. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Preference triple record
demo.program:
triple = {"prompt": "Explain rain.",
            "chosen": "Rain is condensed water vapor falling.",
            "rejected": "idk"}
assert triple["chosen"] != triple["rejected"]
print("triple ok")

title: JAH Tool-Use Traces
summary: Signature-authored plan for 1M agentic tool-use traces with verifiable outcomes.
details: JAH Tool-Use Traces is a JAH-original design for one million agent trajectories (tool calls, observations, final answers) in sandboxed environments where outcomes are verifiable — code execution, web navigation on test sites, calculator use. Each trace records the full action-observation loop so models learn tool use from successes and corrected failures. Labeled Signature.

demo.title: Trace step record
demo.program:
trace = {"task": "add 2+2", "steps": [
    {"action": "calc('2+2')", "obs": "4"},
    {"action": "answer('4')", "obs": "correct"}]}
print("steps:", len(trace["steps"]), "| outcome:", trace["steps"][-1]["obs"])

details: This JAH-designed plan compiles ten million chemical reactions from open patents and journals, each with reactants, products, conditions, and reported yield. title: Signature Sensor Streams
summary: Signature-authored plan for labeled IoT sensor time-series across 50 device types.
details: This JAH-designed plan collects labeled sensor streams (temperature, vibration, current, air quality) from 50 device types for training anomaly-detection and forecasting models. The design specifies sampling rates, calibration metadata, and an anomaly-label schema. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Anomaly label check
demo.program:
stream = [{"t": 0, "v": 21.0}, {"t": 1, "v": 21.2}, {"t": 2, "v": 89.5}]
mean = sum(p["v"] for p in stream) / len(stream)
anoms = [p for p in stream if abs(p["v"] - mean) > 20]
print("anomalies:", len(anoms))

title: Signature Accessibility Captions
summary: Signature-authored plan for 50M alt-text pairs written to accessibility standards.
details: This JAH-designed plan produces fifty million image alt-text pairs written to WCAG accessibility standards — describing who, what, and context — reviewed by accessibility experts on a sampled slice. The design makes models generate genuinely useful descriptions for blind users. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Alt-text quality rubric
demo.program:
alt = "A young girl rides a red bicycle past a bakery on a sunny street."
checks = {"has_who": "girl" in alt, "has_what": "bicycle" in alt,
          "has_where": "street" in alt, "not_too_long": len(alt) < 200}
print(checks, "->", "pass" if all(checks.values()) else "fail")

title: JAH Red-Team Prompts
summary: Signature-authored plan for 200K adversarial prompts with safe-completion pairs.
details: JAH Red-Team Prompts is a JAH-original design for two hundred thousand adversarial prompts (jailbreak attempts, prompt injections, social-engineering lures) each paired with a safe completion demonstrating correct refusal or safe handling. The design versions the attack taxonomy so defenses can be measured per attack family. Labeled Signature.

demo.title: Attack taxonomy coverage
demo.program:
taxonomy = ["jailbreak", "injection", "social_engineering", "roleplay"]
prompts = [{"attack": "jailbreak"}, {"attack": "injection"}]
covered = {p["attack"] for p in prompts}
print("missing families:", [t for t in taxonomy if t not in covered])

title: Signature United Master Corpus
summary: Signature-authored plan unifying all Signature compilations into one versioned master corpus.
details: The Signature United Master Corpus is the JAH-designed capstone: a versioned union of every Signature compilation in this database, with a master license ledger, global dedup across compilations, and a mixture recipe weighting each source by quality tier. Each release is checksummed and changelogged. Labeled Signature throughout — the united master of the Signature data program.

demo.title: Master mixture ledger
demo.program:
sources = {"web_tier1": 0.30, "instruction_forge": 0.15, "code_quarry": 0.15,
            "multimodal": 0.10, "speech": 0.10, "other": 0.20}
assert abs(sum(sources.values()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
print("master mixture valid:", len(sources), "sources")
